title: The track name column can be widened and its buttons never overlap
goal: The column of track names on the left of the timeline is too narrow: a track's name, its hide and key buttons pile on top of each other. The person can drag the column's edge to make it wider or narrower, the width is remembered, and at any width the name shortens before any button overlaps another.
notes:
User's words: "the labels area of the tracks can't be resized, and it's so small the buttons overlap." Screenshot 2026-10-03 17.14.27: V7 expanded with a red hide (eye-slash) button and a purple key diamond touching each other at the right edge of the header.

From code reading (not run): the column is a fixed constant, TimelineDock.gutter = 84 (TimelineDock.swift:45). Header width math at TimelineTrackRows.swift:165 (gutter - indent - switchesWidth - twistWidth - keyWidth) and frame at :184; other uses at TimelineDock.swift:476 (Time row), TimelineTrackRows.swift:291, :983, :1047, and MotionStripView.labelWidth 92 (MotionStripView.swift:37) for the property rows. Making it a stored value means every one of those reads the live width. Trap: the lane/canvas x mapping (ruler, playhead, drops) is offset by the gutter; check nothing assumes the constant. Trap: the track-carry gesture (simultaneousGesture at TimelineTrackRows.swift:192) must not steal the edge drag.
acceptance: Reproduce first: photograph the track column at Next defaults with a track that has its switches and a key diamond showing (the user's screenshot shows V7's hide button and key diamond touching), and MEASURE the gaps between name, buttons and diamond in the audit

Dragging the right edge of the track column resizes it live, with a resize cursor on hover, between a measured minimum (every switch fits with at least 4 pt gaps and a few characters of the name) and a sensible maximum; double-click on the edge returns to the default
The width is remembered across windows and launches (per user, not per document)
The default width is wide enough that a track with all its switches and a key diamond shows the name 'V10' in full with no overlap, MEASURED
At every width from minimum to maximum no two controls in a header overlap, MEASURED at min, default and max and written in the audit; the name truncates with an ellipsis first
The Time row, sound rows, caption rows and group rows follow the same width
A walk at Next defaults drags the edge narrower and wider and photographs both
Audit under queue/audits/; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.
